record.rationale: Translates named native SearchItem members for Writer ExecuteSearch from actual UNO PropertyValues or browser scalar records. Retains caller property order and the source admission rule, including precedence of a complete Any-encoded argument over dotted members. Populates and projects the shared pooled SvxSearchItem. The modeless dialog exchanges its browser draft, while named requests and raw pooled requests use the item values.
